rows: Confirm the machine has a valid owner and the actual target positions are loaded.
Read denied-world-action status. Ask an authorized owner/admin to resolve permission, rather than disabling protection as the first fix.
Check the entire construction bounds, including roofs, overhangs and below-ground layers.
Refill the correct construction input: logs, stairs, glass, planks. Seeds do not replace a missing wall material.
Supply energy for each placement, farmland/water action or harvest.
For a manual structure, compare each layer and orientation; it has no automatic Build action.
For a modded crop or sapling, check whether its protected PlantAdapter exists. Legacy callback support is intentionally off by default.
Check pending outputs before Demolish or harvest; completed recovery must have somewhere to go.
